title: WaggleDance RCO Pass Presence Gate Conformance Corpus
description: Versioned, deterministic, offline fixture locking the fail-closed behavior of the RCO-pass-presence merge gate (tools/check_rco_pass_present.py, merged in #837) per CLAUDE.md Rule 9a ('RCO absence = NO merge'). refuse_cases enumerate every must-REFUSE scenario: no rco_pass event / silence (no qualifying rco-agent pass on task); rco_pass at a DIFFERENT head than --head; a later changes_requested/finding/blocked veto after a pass (latest_is_veto or has_later_veto); type=message or type=handoff with status=rco_pass (non-decision type ignored even if status matches); wrong rco-agent identity posting the pass (only claude-rco-1 counts). allow_cases enumerate the must-ALLOW: type=decision or rco_review, status=rco_pass, exact --head SHA substring present in message, no later veto from the rco-agent, correct rco-agent. Synthetic events use append-order for latest, stable task_id and 40-hex heads. This corpus + test ensures any future weakening of the gate (e.g. allowing silence, stale head, non-qualifying type, wrong identity, or ignoring later veto) will break the locked test deterministically.
provenance: hand-authored stable event shapes per RCO_PASS_PRESENCE_GATE spec, check_rco_pass_present.py logic (DECISION_TYPES_FOR_PASS, RCO_PASS_STATUSES, veto rules, head-in-message, rco-agent filter, latest-by-index), and BRIDGE_CONSENSUS_APPROVAL_V1; no wallclock, no network, no random, no real tokens/paths; deterministic by event list order only; stable synthetic task_id and heads only
